_note: EXAMPLE supermarket-full manifest: schema-valid, FK-resolving, bilingual (EN/AR). Rooms model staff accommodation (supermarkets rarely sell stays); ratePlans model staff monthly rates + a bread subscription. meal_koshary shows the direct mealCategoryId path (the placeholder id must already exist in the target tenant — a missing id violates meals.meal_category_id (NOT NULL + FK) and fails the import as a raw 500, not a silent null). categoryId/storeId placeholders must match the target tenant or be omitted for handler fallbacks (storeId then falls back to the org's first store). campId is omitted throughout: these files use identity/create mode, which mints a random project id that no manifest can name, and an unresolvable campId is now rejected with a 400 before a single row is written -- set it only to a project the target tenant already owns. Passwords are example-only.
